description: Source code implementing the ImageFunctionHLSL class for translating ESSL image functions into HLSL code, including functions for generating image references, argument lists, size/load/store function bodies, and managing image functions.

classes.name: ImageFunctionHLSL
classes.description: Class responsible for generating HLSL code for image functions used in shader translation.

classes.name: ImageFunctionHLSL::ImageFunction
classes.description: Struct representing an image function with properties like image type, internal format, method, and read-only status.

methods.name: GetImageReference
methods.description: Generates a string reference to an image based on its properties, outputting code to access the image in HLSL.

methods.name: OutputImageFunctionArgumentList
methods.description: Outputs the argument list for an image function based on its method and image type.

methods.name: OutputImageSizeFunctionBody
methods.description: Outputs the body of the size query function for an image, retrieving dimensions.

methods.name: OutputImageLoadFunctionBody
methods.description: Outputs the body of the load function for an image, returning image data.

methods.name: OutputImageStoreFunctionBody
methods.description: Outputs the body of the store function for an image, storing data into the image.

methods.name: useImageFunction
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an image function based on name, type, format, and read-only flag, and registers it for code generation.

methods.name: imageFunctionHeader
methods.description: Generates the header and implementation of all registered image functions.
